description: Internal package for Ginkgo testing framework, handling focus policies and filtering of specs based on focus, regex, labels, and file filters.

methods.name: ApplyNestedFocusPolicyToTree
methods.description: Adjusts focus markings in a tree of test nodes to implement nested focus policy.

methods.name: ApplyFocusToSpecs
methods.description: Sets the Skip property on specs based on focus, regex, label, file, and semantic version filters, and returns the filtered specs along with a boolean indicating programmatic focus presence.
